proper_paired_test.note: proper paired test replaces the arbitrary 0.5 pp threshold from the pre-registration

decisions.H187_note: the pre-registered 0.5 pp threshold was arbitrary; a proper paired test gives +0.13 pp, CI [-0.63,+1.00], i.e. no artifact
decisions.H188_evidence: only 9.6% of the pool has both drugs unseen; 90.4% has exactly one unseen drug

consequence: the marginal baseline retains information from the SEEN drug in 90% of this pool, so 'the model loses to a no-information baseline' is the wrong reading. The correct reading: the model loses wherever the baseline has partial information, and where the baseline truly has none (R66's both-unseen pool) it beats random only marginally (+1.25 pp, CI lower bound 0.00).
